metadata.title: Email marketing and automations
metadata.description: Newsletter strategy, list growth, welcome emails and automations built for relationships, retention and conversion.

hero.emailul_e_cea_mai_directa_conversatie_cu: Email is the most direct conversation with your audience, and we know how to make it work. We create launches that feel like events and mark the moments that matter.

ce_primesti.stabilim_cui_ii_scrii_ce_primeste_din_fi: We decide who you write to, what each email delivers and how often, so you reach the inbox—not spam.
ce_primesti.bun_venit_dupa_prima_comanda_revenire_du: Welcome emails, post-purchase emails and re-engagement after a pause. We write them once and they work on their own.
ce_primesti.produse_noi_oferte_aniversari_sarbatori: New products, offers, anniversaries and holidays. Written, laid out and tested before they go out.
ce_primesti.formulare_motive_bune_de_abonare_si_drum: Forms, compelling reasons to subscribe and the journey from the feed to the inbox.

intrebari.de_ce_email_daca_am_deja_social_media: Why email if I already use social media?
intrebari.pentru_ca_lista_e_a_ta_si_emailul_pleaca: Because the list is yours, and email goes to everyone on it without an algorithm deciding who sees it. And nobody can take it from you.
intrebari.pot_incepe_fara_lista: Can I start without a list?
intrebari.da_incepem_cu_cresterea_listei_si_cu_ema: Yes. We start by growing the list and creating the welcome email, then add the rest as subscribers join.
